newsitem.title: USA: Fedders sees Q3 sales to be more favorable.
newsitem.headline: Fedders sees Q3 sales to be more favorable.

text.p: Fedders Corp said Monday it expects sales for the third quarter to compare "much more favorably" to the prior year, on a percentage-change basis, than they did in the second quarter.
Fedders, an air conditioner manufacturer, said in a release it was looking forward to the "seasonally strong" third quarter, and expected more favorable sales.
The company said sales for the second quarter of fiscal 1997 were poor, but expected, due to cool summer weather in key US markets in 1996.
It said lower sales reflected the impact of large end-of-season industry inventories of air conditioners at both retailers and some manufacturers, excluding Fedders.

Fedders added that these higher inventories will "significantly impact US industry shipments in 1997 and are affecting Fedders' revenues and earnings, particularly in the first half of the fiscal year."
Fedders reported sales in the second quarter of fiscal 1997, ended February 28, 1997, of $60.6 million, compared to $88.3 million in the second quarter of fiscal 1996.
Net income for the second quarter was $2.5 million, or $0.04 per share, compared with $6.4 million, or $0.15 cents per share, in the prior year.
